## MoT — the measure of time, in A.B..C

A.B..C IS THE REVOLUTION (addendum 10, r.003): one revolution of the planet around its star — for Earth, perihelion to perihelion, the financial year — is split into 3600 A-units; each A into 3600 B sub-units; each B into 3600 C sub-sub-units — exactly the celestial UCRS-2525 orbit (HU 0 = perihelion, 3600.3600..3600 = a full orbit). The A.B..C of an INSTANT is its position in the current revolution (0.0000..0000 at perihelion, 3600.3600..3600 at the next). The A.B..C of a LENGTH (a MoT) is days ÷ revolution-days × 3600: the 30.333-day pay MoT is ≈ 298.97 A-units — that is '30.33 converted into the 3600.3600..3600 scale'. The scale never names a planet: on Mars the same functions take sols and the Martian revolution in sols. Behind the scenes only — the glass reads day · hour · minute. · r.005 (addenda 11–13): for EARTH the financial year is EXACTLY 365 days = 3600 A (also written 3600), half = 1800; one A = 8,760 s; the day · hour · minute · second ladder is DERIVED from the scale (one day = 3600 ÷ 365 = 9.3106..3058 A — '24 hr day is split to 3600.3600..3600' is that translation, never a second whole); positions are never clamped (past day 365 reads past 3600, flagged); lengths print their true A (730 d = 7200); below C there is D. Every planet's whole is ITS revolution, perihelion to perihelion; A.B..C is the standard for all planets and the glass converts to the planet's LTU from the Admin panel's Planet LTU table (Mars: Earth hours · minutes · seconds for now). · r.007 (addendum 18): the whole is the EXACT revolution — 365.259636 days = 3600 A (one A = 8,766.23 s), never a rounded 365; the perihelion instant opens the year (default anchor again) and is written in Austin CST STANDARD (UTC−6, never daylight).

## Escrow releases $/min

The payer puts a period's pay UP FRONT into escrow (two weeks or one month for a business). From the deposit day and time the escrow releases amount ÷ (MoT × 1440) per minute, linearly, for the MoT. Released money is visible at once; it is WITHDRAWABLE only from 3 hours after the deposit. A withdrawal is its own transaction and can never take more than is withdrawable then.

Hold: **3 hours**. States: `pending` → `releasing` → `released`.

Invariants:

- money released is never more than money deposited
- a withdrawal never makes the available balance negative
- the rate is amount ÷ MoT-minutes and nothing else
- a transaction is amount · deposit day and time · MoT — always the three fields
- the record is append-only and chain-hashed
